### Licence caveats

- **OneStopEnglish corpus and OneStopQA**: the texts come from onestopenglish.com (Macmillan) articles based on Guardian news; the corpus authors release them under CC BY-SA 4.0, but the rights in the underlying articles were not independently verified.
- **args.me (webis/args_me)**: the arguments were crawled from debate portals (idebate.org, debatewise.org and others) whose own terms were not independently verified.
